svg.title: @withone/mastra
svg.desc: Gmail, Slack, Linear, HubSpot, Stripe and 1000+ more apps flow through One into Mastra as oneTools, oneStep and oneTrigger. Install with npm i @withone/mastra.
svg.text: The apps you've connected on One, as tools,
workflow steps and triggers for Mastra agents.
No OAuth code. No provider SDKs.
